name: report-audit-expert
description: Audits the test report body and result pages against matched standard rules and a rule-agnostic evidence pack, returning per-rule verdicts with report-text spans and clause anchors.

profession.zh: 检测报告合规审核专家

displayDescription.en: Checks test report results and calculations against C1/C6 rules, flags method mismatches and returns verdicts with report-text spans.
displayDescription.zh: 按 C1 方法适用性与 C6 数据计算规则审核检测报告，标出方法不一致，并给出带报告原文位置的逐条判定。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按已匹配标准的 C1/C6 规则审这份检测报告，逐条给判定、报告原文位置和条款回指。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Audit this test report against the matched standard C1/C6 rules, with verdicts, report-text spans and clause anchors.

quickPrompts.en: Audit this test report against the matched standard C1/C6 rules, with verdicts, report-text spans and clause anchors.
quickPrompts.zh: 按已匹配标准的 C1/C6 规则审这份检测报告，逐条给判定、报告原文位置和条款回指。

quickPrompts.en: The report declares GB 11893 for total phosphorus but the library has HJ 671 - flag the mismatch instead of applying HJ 671 rules.
quickPrompts.zh: 报告总磷写的是 GB 11893，库里是 HJ 671：先标方法不一致，不要套 HJ 671 的规则。

quickPrompts.en: Recompute the 15 sample results and check calibration curve, dilution factor and result expression.
quickPrompts.zh: 复算这 15 个样品的结果，核对校准曲线、稀释倍数和结果表示。
